items.title: Meta releases Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full frontier models
items.summary: Meta Superintelligence Lab 推出 Muse Wonder 同 Muse Wonder Full，稱為公司首批 frontier 級模型，主打個人與專業 agent 任務、Active Memory 同 Active Focus；Wonder 已透過 Meta Model API 同 Muse Code 開放，輸入約 US$4／百萬 token、輸出約 US$20，Wonder Full 則僅限 Muse Code 訂戶。
items.note: Meta Newsroom dated Oct 12, 2026 (clock time not stated). TechCrunch coverage 10:56 AM PDT Oct 12 (= 01:56 HKT Oct 13).

items.title: vLLM Semantic Router open-sources Decision 3.0 multimodal decision models
items.summary: vLLM Semantic Router（vllm-sr）喺 Hugging Face 以 Apache 2.0 開源 Decision 3.0 系列六款多模態決策模型（d3 約 26B 至 d3-edge 約 0.6B），以單次前向傳播輸出選項機率而非逐字生成；支援文字、圖片同短片輸入。基準數字來自廠商自身評測，尚未有獨立覆核。
items.note: Weights uploaded Oct 10, 2026 ~09:38 UTC (largest d3); collection still updating ~14h before this brief. Vendor-reported Jev Decision Index figures.

items.title: HK CS: AI City Brain to begin storm-season testing next year
items.summary: 政務司長陳國基接受訪問指，政府正將預警同監測系統整合入人工智能，施政報告提出嘅「AI城市大腦」預計最快明年風季成形並開始測試；計劃明年上半年完成基本設計並展開首階段開發，目標 2028 年首季正式使用。

items.title: ASUS ProArt RTX Spark PCs: first U.S. units arrive Oct 16 from US$2,599
items.summary: 華碩確認 ProArt P16／P14（NVIDIA RTX Spark）美國首批於 10 月 16 日到貨，全球預購已於 10 月 7 日開始，Best Buy 起價約 US$2,599（24GB）；更高統一記憶體配置（含 64GB／128GB）主要經 ASUS eShop 同 Best Buy 銷售，迷你機 GR1X 稍後推出。
items.note: ASUS pressroom dated Oct 8, 2026 (clock time not stated; press dateline typo shows 2027). Timely hook: first U.S. units Oct 16. Tom's Hardware Oct 7 corroborates preorders and ship date.

items.title: Google Fitbit Edge tracker with AI coaching: pre-order US$179.99, shelves Oct 27
items.summary: Google 推出 Fitbit Edge 運動追蹤器，結合自動辨識運動同 Google Health Coach 個人化指導，建議零售價 US$179.99，現已開放預購，預計 10 月 27 日上架；聲稱最長約 7 日續航，並附三個月 Google Health Premium。
items.note: Google Wearables blog dated Oct 12, 2026; clock time not stated.

items.title: Alibaba Qwen N1 / N1 Pro AI glasses go on sale in China Oct 13; price still unlisted
items.summary: 阿里千問 AI 眼鏡 N1／N1 Pro 按雲栖大會公布於今日（10 月 13 日）喺中國現貨開售，N1 Pro 加入眼動追蹤、虹膜支付同健康監測；至開售前夕官方仍未公布售價，買家需留意定價同押金條款。
items.note: Oct 12 eve-of-sale roundup; original Cloud Summit announce Sep 22 (tuoluo.cn). Official retail price still unpublished as of Oct 12 coverage — uncertain on price.

items.title: Salesforce to acquire Loops for agentic analytics inside Tableau
items.summary: Salesforce 宣布已簽署最終協議收購 AI 分析初創 Loops，計劃將其納入 Tableau，強化可解釋業務指標變動、主動監察 KPI，並可經 Slack／電郵觸發嘅 agentic analytics；交易預期於 Salesforce 2027 財政年度 11 月初完成，尚待慣常交割條件。
items.note: Salesforce newsroom dated Oct 12, 2026; clock time not stated. Deal not yet closed.

items.title: FT: Nvidia in early talks to deepen stake in or buy Reflection AI
items.summary: 據《金融時報》引述知情人士，Nvidia 正早期洽談加深投資或收購開源 AI 初創 Reflection AI（已注資約 8 億美元，估值曾報約 250 億美元）；方案或包括 acqui-hire／授權，路透未能獨立核實，雙方未評論，協議仍可能告吹。
items.note: FT report via Reuters/CNBC-TV18 Oct 11, 2026 08:51 IST. Talks early-stage; Reuters could not independently verify.

items.title: IMF’s Georgieva: AI investment supports ~3% global growth; ‘slow-moving tsunami’ for jobs
items.summary: IMF 總裁 Georgieva 喺曼谷年會指 AI 基建投資正支撐全球增長約 3%，並形容 AI 為影響就業、教育同稅收嘅「緩慢海嘯」；IMF 估計長遠約 40% 工作會被增強、降級或淘汰。僅引述報道，唔構成投資建議。
items.note: Reuters via Bangkok Post, published 12 Oct 2026 12:15 ICT (= 13:15 HKT). Quote only; not investment advice.

items.title: Planet Zoo 2 launches on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series
items.summary: Frontier《Planet Zoo 2》今日（10 月 13 日）登陸 PC、PS5 同 Xbox Series；首次加入全水生同飛行動物、水族館／鳥舍，仲可以將動物放返野外 Wildlife Reserves。全球同日約英國時間下午 3 時解鎖。
items.note: Official countdown Oct 12: unlocks all platforms 3pm BST Oct 13 (=22:00 HKT). Steam app 3219030 confirms Oct 13.

items.title: Valor Mortis Napoleonic soulslike launches on PC, PS5, Xbox, and Game Pass
items.summary: Ghostrunner 團隊 One More Level 第一人稱 Soulslike《Valor Mortis》今日推出；玩家係拿破崙軍隊復活士兵，Steam／PS5／Xbox 同步解鎖，並即日加入 Xbox Game Pass。
items.note: Games Press Oct 9: unlock 5:00 PM UTC Oct 13 (=01:00 HKT Oct 14). Xbox Wire confirms day-one Game Pass. Steam app 2828710.

items.title: Deep Dish Dungeon survival Metroidvania launches on PC, Xbox, and Game Pass
items.summary: Behold Studios／Raw Fury 生存探索《Deep Dish Dungeon》今日登陸 Steam、Xbox Series 同 Game Pass；手製迷宮兼有 Metroidvania／製作元素，可單人或最多三人線上合作。
items.note: Gematsu Aug 27 dating post; Steam app 2871520 confirms Oct 13 unlock. Xbox Wire lists day-one Game Pass.

items.title: Trash Day physics raccoon co-op launches on Steam
items.summary: 前 Rocket League 開發者組成嘅 Off By One Games《Trash Day》今日喺 Steam 推出；最多六人扮演浣熊搶垃圾、推馬車去 Raccoon Paradise，有物理同工具解謎。
items.note: Games Press dated Sep 11 for Oct 13 Steam launch; Steam app 3314580 confirms Oct 13.

items.title: Total War: SHOGUN 2 – Complete Edition launches on PC
items.summary: SEGA／Creative Assembly《Total War: SHOGUN 2 - Complete Edition》今日喺 PC（Steam／Epic 等）推出；收錄三個戰役同全部主要 DLC，並有 4K UI、64-bit 同 Mod.io 等現代化更新。
items.note: SEGA release: Oct 13, 2026 at 16:00 BST (=23:00 HKT). Steam app 3846830. Existing owners get legacy DLC free (excl. Blood Pack).

items.title: Double Dealers bluffing auction game enters Steam Early Access
items.summary: Miklagard Studios 3–6 人虛張聲勢拍賣對戰《Double Dealers》今日進入 Steam Early Access；賣家知真實條款，買家要靠談判同虛張聲勢，預計 EA 約六個月。
items.note: Steam store planned release Oct 13, 2026 Early Access; ~6 months EA per store page.

items.title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse due October 15 on PC and consoles
items.summary: Konami／Evil Empire 新 2D《Castlevania: Belmont's Curse》定本周四（10 月 15 日）登陸 PC、PS5、Xbox 同 Switch；故事喺《Castlevania III》23 年後，主角係 Rose Belmont。
items.note: Konami EU topics confirm Oct 15; week-ahead release. Switch (BC on Switch 2 per roundups).

items.title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 launches tomorrow on PC, PS5, and Xbox
items.summary: Auroch／Devolver 復古 FPS 續作《Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2》定明日（10 月 14 日）登陸 PC、PS5 同 Xbox；可玩 Ultramarine 或 Sister of Battle，Switch 2 版稍後跟進。
items.note: Steam confirms Oct 14, 2026. Warp Pipes/week roundups note Switch 2 later, no date.

items.title: Epic Games reportedly orders AI-first development on Disney shooter
items.summary: VGC 引 Bloomberg：Epic 據報要求未公布嘅迪士尼合作射擊遊戲改「AI-first」製作、減少手寫程式；Tim Sweeney 亦公開提到公司正大規模轉向 AI 加速。
items.note: VGC 12th Oct 2026 / 8:43 pm UK (BST→HKT +7h = 03:43 Oct 13). Based on Bloomberg report; Epic confirmed AI-accelerated stance in statement. Marked uncertain as internal details are reported.

items.title: Battlefield 6 joins Xbox Game Pass as Season 5 begins
items.summary: 《Battlefield 6》今日加入 Xbox Game Pass Ultimate／PC Game Pass；同日開 Season 5（Siege of Vegas），EA Play 會員可領 Deployment Pack 同賽季獎勵。
items.note: Xbox Wire dated Oct 7 listing Oct 13 arrival; event is today. Season 5 same-day per EA/Xbox coverage.

items.title: UnderMire co-op roguelite horror dated for Steam November 13
items.summary: Table Knight Games 手繪合作 Roguelite 恐怖《UnderMire》定 11 月 13 日喺 Steam 推出；最多四人落Bunker，有 SMUSH 合成系統同距離語音，Demo 已上線。
items.note: Gematsu Oct 12, 2026 / 2:30 PM EDT → 22:30 HKT.

items.title: Nintendo: no plans to ditch physical games on Switch 2
items.summary: 任天堂拉丁美洲 VP Bill van Zyll 表示公司「冇計劃放棄實體」；強調 Switch 2 剛過一年、同時支援數位同實體，會跟消費者喜好。
items.note: Nintendo Life relative 'Yesterday, 9:30am' when fetched Oct 13 HKT morning → Oct 12 ~9:30am UK (BST) = 16:30 HKT. Also The Verge Oct 12.

items.title: Steam hits record 43.5 million concurrent users
items.summary: Steam 喺 10 月再破同時在線紀錄，達約 4,350 萬人登入；同期遊戲中玩家約 1,450 萬亦創新高。Kotaku 指係今年第三次刷新。
items.note: Kotaku published Oct 12, 2026; clock time not stated on page. Peak figure 43,505,724; in-game ~14.5M. Record dated Oct 11 per X/other coverage.

items.title: Invincible VS Season 2 DLC fighter Angstrom Levy launches today
items.summary: Skybound／Quarter Up《Invincible VS》第二季 DLC 角色 Angstrom Levy 今日推出；係注重 portal／orb 控場嘅 zoning 角色，遊戲喺 PS5、Xbox Series 同 PC 可玩。
items.note: Gematsu Oct 1 dating for Oct 13 launch; Season 2 starts with this fighter.

items.title: The Coalition: Gears of War: E-Day hit by DDoS over the weekend
items.summary: 《Gears of War: E-Day》開發商 The Coalition 確認週末遭受 DDoS，導致登入同斷線問題；團隊持續監控緩解，呼籲玩家耐心。
items.note: VGC 12th Oct 2026 / 4:00 pm UK (BST→HKT +7h = 23:00 HKT). Coalition post dated Oct 12.

items.title: Sifu kung-fu brawler launches on iOS and Android
items.summary: Sloclap 功夫動作《Sifu》已於 10 月 12 日登陸 iOS 同 Android；原作已喺 PS／Xbox／Switch／PC 推出，今次補齊手機版。
items.note: Gematsu Oct 1 dating for Oct 12 mobile launch. Exact clock time not stated.
